invariant: A drafted document whose typed delivery shape contradicts its own members (workspace_contract / fixture_builder / fixture_blueprints / an output with format_id=workspace_bundle next to an output kind other than 'directory') is a representation error: it raises DELIVERY_SHAPE_SELF_CONTRADICTION as a repairable DraftProjectionError with field-level public diagnostics naming the conflicting output kind and the members it contradicts, before profile admission can misclassify it as an unsupported need (no repair) or a code-only projection error (blind repair). Consistent workspace documents and genuine single-artifact documents are untouched.
